entry.summary: Access is tightly controlled. Foreign visitors need a TAAF visa with the senior administrator's prior approval, requested at least two months ahead. Going ashore needs the district chief's authorisation, and integral protection zones are closed.
entry.next_check: Confirm the rule for this territory on France-Visas.

laws.rule: Landing requires prior authorisation from the TAAF prefect; the islands are a national nature reserve and some zones are closed to all access.
Foreign nationals need a visa issued only after the TAAF senior administrator agrees; ask at least two months before arrival.
